guarantee: A reopened review identifies the comparison it can reproduce and preserves the operands it can still read: a recorded tree comparison its recorded tree ids, and a dataset comparison of an unconverted repository its recorded snapshots and code endpoints. Once the repository's official memory line is converted, a leaf that recorded only a dataset comparison keeps its code sides and states its knowledge sides as legacy-unavailable. Reconstruction and missing channels remain explicit instead of borrowing unrelated state.
title: Reproducible review history
